revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth 3.7%, FY2024 1.7%; unit expansion plus pricing give about 5% fading to 3.5% toward terminal growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 EBIT margin 46.1% (12,393/26,885), FY2023-25 range 45.7-46.1%; held flat at 46%.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: US federal statutory rate 21%; Damodaran industry effective rate 9.9% not used as it is low and not MCD-specific.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 D&A/revenue 457/26,885 = 1.7% (as reported by deskstack).

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex/revenue 12.5% (3,365/26,885), FY2024 10.7%; 12% reflects continued restaurant openings.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 0.95 (Damodaran Restaurant/Dining unlevered cash-corrected 0.783, D/E 0.272, tax 21%) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = 9.1% cost of equity; pre-tax Kd 5.07% gives 4.0% after tax; weights 78.6/21.4 (industry) give about 8.0%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: lowered from 3.0% to 2.5% (inflation plus slight real growth, well below 4.86% risk-free) to temper terminal value share of EV flagged by review.

net_debt.source: deskstack derived net_debt = LT debt noncurrent 39,973 + current LTD 725 + commercial paper 798 - cash 774; 10-K accession 0000063908-26-000035; excludes leases.

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares 716.4 million (EPS 11.95 on net income 8,563m is consistent), us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding, accession 0000063908-26-000035; in millions to match money scale.
